claims.label: Erica Kirk was inside Hopkinson Aircrafts office when notified of Charlie Kirk's death
claims.claim: Per an unverified source tip received by the host, Erica Kirk was at Hopkinson Aircrafts in Scottsdale on September 10, 2025 when she received the call informing her that Charlie Kirk had died.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain direct documentary confirmation (call logs, eyewitnesses, building entry records) corroborating Erica Kirk's presence at Hopkinson Aircrafts on 9/10.

claims.label: Hopkinson Aircrafts occupies a separate unmarked building using Atlantic Aviation's mailing address
claims.claim: Per the host's anonymous outreach to Atlantic Aviation, Hopkinson Aircrafts is located in a standalone building separate from the Atlantic FBO terminal at 14600 North Aircraft Drive, Scottsdale, but Atlantic receives all Hopkinson mail.
claims.investigative_direction: Conduct independent site visit or obtain satellite/aerial confirmation of a separate building; verify postal/mail arrangement through public records.

claims.label: Barbara plane (N8724A) charter operator states all their planes have Wi-Fi
claims.claim: The charter company handling the Hawker Beechcraft N8724A told the host by phone on March 24, 2026 that "all of our planes have Wi-Fi."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain written confirmation from the charter operator; corroborate via independent review of charter marketing materials.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk's plane was below 7,500 ft approaching Provo at 3:26 PM MST on September 10, 2025
claims.claim: ADSB Exchange data shows Charlie Kirk's plane at 3:26 PM MST descending below 7,500 feet, minutes from touching down at Provo.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull and archive ADSB Exchange historical data for N-number of Charlie's plane on 9/10/2025 between 15:00–16:00 MST.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet texted "Sorry, on the plane. This just loaded" at 3:26 PM MST
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet sent a text message at 3:26 PM MST on September 10, 2025 stating "Sorry, on the plane. This just loaded," referencing a 1:30 PM MST message he had not previously answered.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original text record with carrier timestamp metadata to confirm the 3:26 PM MST time.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet was unreachable from 1:47 PM MST until at least 4:18 PM MST because he was on a plane without Wi-Fi
claims.claim: Per a text thread with Justin and Aubrey, Andrew Kolvet could not respond to messages because he was on a plane without Wi-Fi; Justin told Aubrey at 4:18 PM MST that she must wait until Andrew is "on the ground."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full text thread with carrier-verified timestamps; reconcile against ADSB data for the plane Andrew was on.

claims.label: N40JD plane departed Scottsdale approximately one hour after Charlie Kirk was shot and landed at Provo at 2:29 PM MST
claims.claim: Per the host, the N40JD plane, registered to Jason Knupp (identified by host as chief commander of naval surface force in Atlanta), departed Scottsdale about one hour after the shooting and landed at Provo at 2:29 PM MST.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Jason Knupp's military role via official Navy / public records; pull ADSB data for N40JD on 9/10; investigate passenger manifest.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet guest-hosted the first hour of Charlie Kirk Live Show on September 10, 2025
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated in an interview with Ross Douthat (New York Times) that he guest-hosted the first hour of Charlie Kirk Live Show on September 10, 2025, because Charlie was focusing on the tour.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the show aired live (not pre-recorded) by obtaining written confirmation from guest Nick Shirley, YouTube upload timestamps, and production records.

claims.label: Nick Shirley claims to have infiltrated Comando Vermelho in 48 hours
claims.claim: Nick Shirley stated on the September 10, 2025 Charlie Kirk Live Show that within 48 hours he gained access to Comando Vermelho, one of Rio de Janeiro's largest gangs, and befriended soldiers who could not leave the favela.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the Comando Vermelho footage, dates, and circumstances of Shirley's claimed access; check corroborating reporting.

claims.label: Joe Kent acknowledged federal investigators did not thoroughly pursue other leads
claims.claim: Joe Kent stated in an interview with Michael Shellenberger that federal investigators did not thoroughly pursue other leads in the Charlie Kirk case.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Shellenberger-Kent interview; cross-reference Kent's stated investigation recommendations against DOJ / FBI disclosures.

claims.label: Blake Neff characterized Joe Kent's potential truthful defense testimony as a "betrayal"
claims.claim: Blake Neff stated on air that if Joe Kent testifies truthfully for the defense that federal investigation was not thorough, it would be a "level of betrayal" against Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full clip with timestamps; document exact wording for evidentiary comparison against later statements.

claims.label: The "Wi-Refi" plane's 2020 charter listing does not market Wi-Fi as an amenity
claims.claim: A 2020 charter listing for the plane identified as the alleged Santa Barbara → Scottsdale leg ("Wi-Refi") lists amenities including belted lavatory, cabin power outlets, refreshment center, and satellite phone, but does not list Wi-Fi.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain current charter operator records to verify whether the aircraft has been retrofitted with Wi-Fi since 2020.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet admitted Charlie Kirk was displeased about a booking Kolvet had made the day before September 10
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated in his Ross Douthat interview that Charlie Kirk was "not super pleased" about an interview booking Kolvet had made the day before September 10, prompting Charlie to hand guest-host duties to Kolvet.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the specific guest booked for September 9 interview; cross-check against show archives.

claims.label: "Wi-Refi" / "RY Reef air" and the alleged Santa Barbara → Scottsdale plane share identity
claims.claim: The host identifies "RY Reef air" and "Wi-Refi" as the same plane – the aircraft Erica Kirk described to the host as being used by Andrew Kolvet for the Santa Barbara → Scottsdale leg.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether "Wi-Refi" is a transcript rendering of a specific aircraft name (e.g., "WiRefi Air") or a phonetic rendering by Erica Kirk.

claims.label: Baron Coleman clip characterizes TPUSA's selective-response strategy as "Gish gallop" and bad-faith debating
claims.claim: Baron Coleman (in a clip played on the show) characterized TPUSA's pattern of ignoring major inconsistencies while responding only to minor debunkable details as Gish gallop and bad-faith debating.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the Baron Coleman clip is preserved as a discrete artifact; clarify node for Baron Coleman.

claims.label: TPUSA released a statement that Marina reported as needing Andrew Kolvet's input
claims.claim: Per a text thread, after Charlie Kirk's death, TPUSA staff member Marina was told by another staffer that the statement about Charlie's death required Andrew Kolvet's input before release.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full text thread; identify timestamp when TPUSA's public statement went out.
